carries: the condition of the goal being cleared; no reason, no iterations; written for a clear of an ACTIVE goal in both claude -p and an interactive session
collector_reads_as: cleared; read as the evaluator's met verdict before this capture
differs_from_set: the same record as the set sentinel except met is true instead of false

order: after the clear sentinel, claude -p only; the condition is restated after the prefix

evaluator_verdict_after: the second goal's own met true verdict carries the second condition
meaning: replacing an active goal writes a second set sentinel (met false, sentinel true) with the new condition and a second Goal set: local_command; no clear record and no verdict for the first goal

carries: the condition and the evaluator's reason, repeated once per iteration while the goal is open; no sentinel, no iterations, no durationMs

after_it: a hook_cancelled attachment and the turn ends; the goal's later state was not measured
carries: the condition, the reason, iterations, durationMs, tokens, and a failed key present only here

meaning: resuming a session with --resume while its goal is active writes no new sentinel and no local_command record; the evaluator's not-met verdicts continue on the next turn

after_clear: a user record with isMeta true that quotes the goal as stop-hook feedback, then a stop_hook_summary system record
clear_command_records: none: the typed /goal clear is not written as a command record and no Goal cleared: line is written; the clear sentinel (met true, sentinel true) is the only trace
drove_with: tmux, an interactive claude session in a scratch folder, one /goal then /goal clear then /exit
set_command_records: a user record whose message.content opens with <command-name> and a second user record whose message.content opens with <local-command-stdout>Goal set:; no system local_command record and no commandRun key
set_sentinel: the same goal_status attachment as claude -p, written before the command's user record

over_limit_result: a system local_command record whose printed text begins Goal condition is limited to 4000 characters; no goal_status attachment is written, so no goal is set; the -p result carries the same sentence

not_captured: a goal restored by resume that is then met (the met goal had cleared itself before the resume)
